name: BASICS Acrylic Paint Set, 12 x 22 ml
bestUse: Best for mixing your own tints for small decorative clay pieces
descriptionOriginal: Twelve 22 ml tubes of medium-viscosity, satin-finish acrylic in primaries, earth tones, black and white.
whyWeLikeIt: With a proper white and a handful of strong colours you can mix your own blush, butter and sage, and the tubes keep going into later projects.
limitations: There is no ready-made pink or pastel in the box: soft shades mean mixing from the white, and the finish is satin, not matte. The maker lists surfaces such as stone and ceramics but does not name air-dry clay, so try a colour on a scrap first.
qualityNote: Customers like the colour variety and the blending; some say the amount of paint varies.
verificationSource: Listing: sold by Amazon.com; 12 tubes stated. inTheBox: Twelve 22 ml tubes: primary yellow, cadmium orange, alizarin crimson, primary red, dioxazine purple, primary blue, phthalocyanine green, light green, burnt sienna, burnt umber, titanium white and black.
